item.title: Sheikh Mohammed extends warm Diwali wishes to Indian community in UAE and worldwide
item.description: His Highness Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum, Vice President and Prime Minister of the UAE and Ruler of Dubai, extended warm Diwali wishes to the Indian community in the UAE and worldwide. Through a message on his X account, he wished peace, safety, and prosperity to all celebrating the festival of lights during this special occasion.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: ‘Shouted, cursed, and tossed maps’: Trump urged Zelenskyy to accept Putin’s terms or be ‘destroyed’ — Inside US meeting with Ukraine
item.description: President Trump reportedly urged Ukrainian President Zelenskyy to accept Putin's terms to end the war, warning of destruction if Ukraine refused. During a contentious meeting, Trump discarded battlefield maps and echoed Russian talking points, ultimately declining to supply long-range missiles.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Hong Kong plane crash: Cargo jet skids off runway into water; two dead
item.description: A cargo plane from Dubai skidded off the runway at Hong Kong International Airport early Monday, plunging into the sea. The Emirates SkyCargo flight collided with a ground-service vehicle, tragically killing two workers. The four crew members on board the Boeing 747 freighter were unharmed.

item.title: Who is Emiru? Exploring the personal life of the popular streamer who was allegedly assaulted at TwitchCon
item.description: Popular Twitch streamer Emiru, known for her engaging content and cosplays, has amassed nearly 2 million followers and co-owns the OTK network. Her career highlights include inspiring a League of Legends character design and becoming OTK co-owner. In October 2025, an alleged assault at TwitchCon sparked crucial conversations about creator safety at events.

item.title: Twitch releases statement following Emiru’s alleged assault at TwitchCon
item.description: Twitch streamer Emiru was assaulted at a TwitchCon meet-and-greet, prompting a community backlash over security. Twitch condemned the act, banned the perpetrator, and is increasing security at check-in areas. However, critics like Valkyrae highlight past denials of personal security for streamers, questioning the platform's commitment to creator safety.

item.title: Watch: Israel bombards Hamas sites in Gaza Strip, 33 killed; fate of truce unclear
item.description: Israel launched airstrikes and artillery attacks on dozens of Hamas targets in Gaza after the group reportedly violated a ceasefire. The IDF struck weapon storage sites, military infrastructure, and a six-kilometer underground tunnel. Gaza's civil defense reported at least 33 killed in the Israeli strikes.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Gunman opens fire in Oklahoma State University dorm; three injured, one confirmed student among victims
item.description: Tragedy struck Oklahoma State University's homecoming weekend as a dorm shooting left three injured early Sunday. The incident unfolded at Carreker East residential hall after an off-campus party migrated indoors. One victim is confirmed as an OSU student. Authorities are investigating the shooting, with details on the suspect and motive still emerging.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: 'They will be hunted, and killed': 3 die after US launches strike on 'drug' vessel — watch video
item.description: The US Department of War confirmed a lethal strike on October 17th, targeting a vessel linked to the ELN terrorist organization. Three individuals, described as "narco-terrorists," were killed in international waters. Officials vowed to hunt down and eliminate such groups, likening them to Al Qaeda in their threat to national security and the American populace.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: What was Saudi Arabia’s Kafala system and why its abolition is a historic moment for migrant workers
item.description: Saudi Arabia has officially abolished the controversial 'kafala' sponsorship system, ending over 50 years of a framework that tied foreign workers' residency and rights to employers. This significant reform, part of Vision 2030, grants millions of migrant workers freedom to change jobs and leave the country without sponsor approval, aiming to boost dignity and reduce exploitation.

item.title: Explained: Why Donald Trump thinks his father isn't in heaven - and he also won't go there
item.description: Donald Trump grapples with doubts few would expect from a man who has always commanded certainty. Convinced his mother rests in heaven but uncertain about his father, he frames his late-stage peace efforts—from Ukraine to Israel-Hamas, not as accolades but as a moral wager. Having inherited Fred Sr.’s ruthless drive, Trump fears he may have also inherited his father’s spiritual liabilities.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Saudi Arabia anounces new 2025–26 school calendar: Winter Shift, fewer semesters; key dates every parent must know
item.description: Saudi Arabia's Ministry of Education is ushering in a new academic year with a return to a two-semester system and a winter shift. Schools in major cities will begin earlier, from November 2, 2025, to February 17, 2026. New autumn and mid-year breaks are introduced, alongside adjusted schedules for regions like Makkah and Madinah, and shorter hours during Ramadan.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Jeffrey Epstein sent nasty emails to billionaire Leon Black to pressurise him for millions, reports claim
item.description: Leaked emails reveal Jeffrey Epstein's aggressive demands for millions from Leon Black, threatening financial disruption and criticizing Black's advisors and children. Black continued paying Epstein over $150 million for wealth management services, even after Epstein's 2004 sex offense charges, until Epstein's 2019 arrest.
